# Data dan Eksplorasi Awal
```{r}
data<-read.csv("D:/Kuliah/Semester 5/Metode Peramalan Deret Waktu/SN_d_tot_V2.0.csv", sep=";")
colnames(data)<-c("Tahun", "Bulan", "Hari", "Desimal", "Sunspot", "SD", "Obs", "Def")
data <- subset(data, Tahun >= 1926 & (Tahun < 2026 | (Tahun == 2025 & Bulan <= 12)))
data
```
```{r}
summary(data$Sunspot)
```
```{r}
colSums(is.na(data))
```
```{r}
plot(data$Desimal, data$Sunspot, 
     type = "l", col = "gray50", 
     xlab = "Tahun", ylab = "Sunspot", 
     main = "Plot Data Mentah Sunspot (1926 - 2025)")
```
```{r}
data_bulanan <- aggregate(Sunspot ~ Tahun + Bulan, data = data, FUN = mean)
data_bulanan <- data_bulanan[order(data_bulanan$Tahun, data_bulanan$Bulan), ]
ts_bulanan <- ts(data_bulanan$Sunspot, start = c(1926, 1), frequency = 12)
```

```{r}
plot(ts_bulanan, 
     type = "l", col = "black", lwd = 1.5,
     xlab = "Tahun", ylab = "Rata-rata Sunspot", 
     main = "Data Bulanan Sunspot (Januari 1926 - Desember 2025)")
```
```{r}
data_tahunan <- aggregate(Sunspot ~ Tahun, data = data, FUN = mean)
ts_tahunan <- ts(data_tahunan$Sunspot, start = 1926, frequency = 1)
plot(ts_tahunan, 
     type = "l", col = "black", lwd = 1.5,
     xlab = "Tahun", ylab = "Rata-rata Sunspot", 
     main = "Data Tahunan Sunspot (Januari 1926 - Desember 2025)")
```
```{r}
dec_sunspot <- decompose(ts_bulanan, type = "additive")
plot(dec_sunspot)
```
```{r}
seasonplot(ts_bulanan, 
           s = 132, 
           main = "Seasonal Plot of Sunspot (11-Year Cycle)", 
           ylab = "Jumlah Sunspot",
           xlab = "Bulan ke- dalam Siklus",
           year.labels = TRUE, 
           col = rainbow(10), 
           pch = 19)
```

```{r}
monthplot(ts_bulanan, ylab = "Sunspot (ppm)", col = "darkblue", 
          main = "Monthplot Data Sunspot")
```
```{r}
ggplot(data, aes(x = as.factor(Tahun), y = Sunspot)) +
  geom_boxplot(fill = "orange", color = "black", outlier.size = 1) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, size = 8)) +
  labs(title = "Sebaran Sunspot Bulanan per Tahun",
       x = "Tahun",
       y = "Jumlah Sunspot")
```
```{r}
min(ts_bulanan)
```

# Pembagian Training dan Testing Data
```{r}
ts_sunspot<-ts_bulanan
n_total <- length(ts_sunspot)
n_test <- 240
n_train <- n_total - n_test

train_data <- window(ts_sunspot, end = time(ts_sunspot)[n_train])
test_data <- window(ts_sunspot, start = time(ts_sunspot)[n_train + 1])
```
```{r}
plot(train_data, 
     type = "l", col = "black", lwd = 1.5,
     xlab = "Bulan", ylab = "Rata-rata Sunspot", 
     main = "Data Training")
```
```{r}
plot(test_data, 
     type = "l", col = "black", lwd = 1.5,
     xlab = "Bulan", ylab = "Rata-rata Sunspot", 
     main = "Data Testing")
```

```{r}
min(train_data)
```


# Uji Stasioneritas
## Plot ACF PACF
```{r}
acf(train_data, lag.max = 140)
```
```{r}
pacf(train_data, lag.max = 140)
```

## Uji Fligner-Killeen
```{r}
data$Periode <- cut(data$Tahun, 
                         breaks = c(1925, 1950, 1975, 2000, 2026), 
                         labels = c("1926-1950", "1951-1975", "1976-2000", "2001-2025"))

fligner.test(Sunspot ~ Periode, data = data)
```
## Uji ADF
```{r}
tseries::adf.test(train_data)
```
# Penanganan Stasioneritas
```{r}
d1<-diff(train_data) 
plot.ts(d1, lty=1, xlab="Waktu", ylab="Data Difference Non-Seasonal 1 Sunspot", main="Plot Difference")
```
```{r}
tahun_d1 <- floor(as.numeric(time(d1)))

df_d1 <- data.frame(
  Tahun = tahun_d1,
  d1 = as.numeric(d1)
)

df_d1$Periode <- cut(df_d1$Tahun, 
                     breaks = c(1925, 1950, 1975, 2000, 2026), 
                     labels = c("1926-1950", "1951-1975", "1976-2000", "2001-2026"))

fligner.test(d1 ~ Periode, data = df_d1)
```
```{r}
tseries::adf.test(d1)
```

# Non-Seasonal
## ACF
```{r}
acf(d1, lag.max = 140)
```
Indikasi q=2.

## PACF
```{r}
pacf(d1, lag.max = 400)
```
Indikasi p=3 atau p=0, q=2, d=1.
```{r}
eacf(d1)
```

# Seasonal 
## Lag 11
### Differencing
```{r}
D1 <- diff(d1, lag = 132) 
plot.ts(D1, lty=1, xlab="Waktu", ylab="Data Difference Seasonal 1 Sunspot", main="Plot Difference Seasonal")
```
Indikasi D=1, s=132.



### ACF setelah differencing musiman
```{r}
acf(D1, lag.max = 396, main = "ACF Setelah Differencing Musiman 132")
```
ACF cut off setelah lag musiman, indikasi Seasonal MA (Q=1). Indikasi q=2
### PACF setelah differencing
```{r}
pacf(D1, lag.max = 396, main = "PACF Setelah Differencing Musiman 132")
```
PACF tails off di lag musiman dan kelipatannya, indikasi Seasonal AR (P=0). Indikasi p=5.
###EACF
```{r}
eacf(D1)
```


## Lag 5
### Differencing
```{r}
D2 <- diff(d1, lag = 60) 
plot.ts(D2, lty=1, xlab="Waktu", ylab="Data Difference Seasonal 1 Sunspot", main="Plot Difference Seasonal")
```
### ACF setelah differencing
```{r}
acf(D2, lag.max = 300, main = "ACF Setelah Differencing Musiman 60")
```
ACF cut off setelah lag musiman, indikasi Q=1. Indikasi q=1.
### PACF setelah differencing
```{r}
pacf(D2, lag.max = 300, main = "PACF Setelah Differencing Musiman 60")
```
PACF tails off di lag musiman dan kelipatan, indikasi P=0. Indikasi p=2 atau p=3.

# Diagnostik Model
## Visual
```{r}
sisaan <- residuals(model6)
plot(sisaan, main = "Data Log(Sunspot)", ylab = "Log", xlab = "Tahun")
acf(sisaan, main = "ACF", lag.max = 55)
pacf(sisaan, main = "PACF", lag.max = 55)
```
```{r}
car::qqPlot(sisaan)
plot(c(1:length(sisaan)),sisaan)
acf(sisaan)
pacf(sisaan)
```
## Uji Formal
### Sisaan menyebar normal

```{r}
shapiro.test(sisaan)
```


### Sisaan saling bebas
```{r}
Box.test(sisaan, type = "Ljung", lag=120) 
```

### Sisaan memiliki ragam homogen
```{r}
Box.test((sisaan)^2, type = "Ljung", lag=120)  
```
### Nilai harapan sama dengan nol
```{r}
t.test(sisaan, mu = 0, conf.level = 0.95) 
```

# Forecasting
```{r}
ramalan_sarima = forecast::forecast(model6, 240)
ramalan_sarima
```
```{r}
prediksi_asli <- ramalan_sarima$mean
batas_bawah_asli <- ramalan_sarima$lower[, 2]
batas_atas_asli <- ramalan_sarima$upper[, 2]

prediksi_asli
```
```{r}
prediksi_asli <- ramalan_sarima$mean
batas_bawah   <- ramalan_sarima$lower[, 2]
batas_atas    <- ramalan_sarima$upper[, 2]

waktu_ramalan <- seq(from = 2006, by = 1/12, length.out = length(prediksi_asli))

plot(window(ts_bulanan, end = c(2005, 12)), 
     type = "l", col = "black", lwd = 1.5,
     xlim = c(1926, 2026), 
     ylim = c(0, max(ts_bulanan, batas_atas, na.rm = TRUE) + 30),
     main = "Peramalan Sunspot Bulanan (1926 - 2026)",
     xlab = "Tahun", ylab = "Jumlah Sunspot")

polygon(c(waktu_ramalan, rev(waktu_ramalan)),
        c(batas_bawah, rev(batas_atas)),
        col = rgb(0, 0, 1, 0.2), border = NA)

lines(waktu_ramalan, prediksi_asli, col = "blue", lwd = 2, lty = 2)
lines(window(ts_bulanan, start = c(2006, 1)), col = "red", lwd = 1.5)
abline(v = 2005, col = "gray50", lty = 3, lwd = 2)

legend("topleft", 
       legend = c("Data Latih (1926-2005)", "Data Uji Aktual (2006-2025)", 
                  "Prediksi SARIMA", "Batas 95%"),
       col = c("black", "red", "blue", "blue"), 
       lty = c(1, 1, 2, 1), lwd = c(1.5, 1.5, 2, 10),
       fill = c(NA, NA, NA, rgb(0,0,1,0.2)), border = NA, bty = "n")
```
```{r}
autoplot(ramalan_sarima, col="blue")
```

```{r}
accuracy(ramalan_sarima,test_data)
```



# Model TBATS
## Model Pertama
```{r}
model_tbats <- tbats(
  y = train_data, 
  seasonal.periods = c(12, 132)
)

summary(model_tbats)

```
```{r}
model_tbats
```


```{r}
ramalan_tbats <- forecast::forecast(model_tbats, h = 240)
ramalan_tbats
```


```{r}
plot(ramalan_tbats, main = "Peramalan TBATS untuk Sunspot Bulanan")
lines(test_data, col = "red") 
```
```{r}
accuracy(ramalan_tbats, test_data)
```
```{r}
sisaan_tbats<-residuals(model_tbats)
plot(sisaan_tbats, main = "Plot Sisaan TBATS", ylab = "Error")
acf(sisaan_tbats, lag.max = 60, main = "ACF Sisaan TBATS")
```
```{r}
shapiro.test(sisaan_tbats)
```

```{r}
t.test(sisaan_tbats, mu = 0)
```
```{r}
Box.test(sisaan_tbats, type = "Ljung-Box", lag=24)
Box.test(sisaan_tbats, type = "Ljung-Box", lag=264)
```
```{r}
Box.test((sisaan_tbats)^2, type = "Ljung", lag=24)  
Box.test((sisaan_tbats)^2, type = "Ljung", lag=264) 
```
```{r}
checkresiduals(model_tbats)
```

## Model kedua (error ke ARIMA)
```{r}
sisaan_tbats <- residuals(model_tbats)
model_resid <- auto.arima(sisaan_tbats)

checkresiduals(model_resid)
```
```{r}
sisaan_resid <- residuals(model_resid)
shapiro.test(sisaan_resid)
t.test(sisaan_resid, mu = 0)
Box.test(sisaan_resid, lag = 24, type = "Ljung-Box")
Box.test(sisaan_resid, lag = 264, type = "Ljung-Box")
Box.test((sisaan_resid)^2, lag = 24, type = "Ljung-Box")
Box.test((sisaan_resid)^2, lag = 264, type = "Ljung-Box")
```

## Hybrid (TBATS+ARIMA)
```{r}
fc_tbats <- forecast::forecast(model_tbats, h = length(test_data))
fc_error <- forecast::forecast(model_resid, h = length(test_data))
ramalan_hybrid <- fc_tbats$mean + fc_error$mean
```

```{r}
test_aktual <- window(ts_bulanan, start = c(2006, 1))
akurasi_hybrid <- accuracy(ramalan_hybrid, test_aktual)
print(akurasi_hybrid)
```

```{r}
test_aktual <- window(ts_bulanan, start = c(2006, 1))
mae_hybrid <- mean(abs(test_aktual - ramalan_hybrid))
mae_naive <- mean(abs(diff(as.numeric(train_data), lag = 132)))
mase_hybrid <- mae_hybrid / mae_naive

cat("MASE Hybrid:", mase_hybrid, "\n")
```
